annotations.title: Render an HTML document to a PDF

description:
Render up to 256 KB of HTML to a PDF. Returns a download link to the PDF.

Give the user the `download_url` so they can open the PDF. The link
works for 15 minutes; after that, render again. The result is
`{"download_url": "<link>", "pages": <page count>, "size_bytes": <PDF size>,
"expires_in_minutes": 15}`.
Only HTML and CSS are rendered; JavaScript is not run.
For documents larger than 256 KB, use the REST API (`POST /v1/render`).

Credits: 1 per call.

html.description: A complete HTML document, up to 256 KB. Inline images, fonts and CSS as data: URIs; external resources are not loaded.

pdf_variant.description: Write the PDF as PDF/A-2b or PDF/A-3b, for archiving. Paid plans only. Leave it out for a regular PDF.
